description: This file provides a wrapper class for interfacing with Supabase's admin REST API using httpx, enabling operations like user creation, link generation, sign-in, and password updates without directly depending on the official supabase-py library.

classes.name: SupabaseAdminClient
classes.description: A minimal client for interacting with Supabase's admin REST endpoints, supporting user management, link generation, and authentication functions.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _headers(self)
methods.description: Property that returns default headers including API key and authorization.

methods.name: str _auth_url(self, path: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for a given API path.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_user(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user in Supabase Auth via REST API.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_link(self, email: str, link_type: str, redirect_to: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Generates a magic, recovery, invite, signup, or email change link for a user.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] password_sign_in(self, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Performs password-based sign-in and returns auth tokens.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] admin_update_password_by_email(self, email: str, new_password: str)
methods.description: Updates a user's password via admin API by their email address.

ctags.signature: (self, email: str, link_type: str, redirect_to: Optional[str] = None)
